svg.title: Community growth since 2018
svg.desc: Line chart, June 2018 to November 2026. Slack members reach 15,193, GitHub organisation members 2,014. Slack passed Twitter followers in March 2022; Twitter tracking stopped in 2023.
svg.text: Slack members, GitHub organisation members and Twitter followers, month by month.

g.text: Faint lines bridge gaps in the data
